decisive_items: Dilated left ventricle with end-diastolic dimension of 6.6 cm
response.rationale: R1 directly links ESKD and elevated creatinine to dilated cardiomyopathy, which is the hallmark of uremic cardiomyopathy. R3 relies on hypertension, a common comorbidity in ESKD, but lacks the direct renal-uremic specificity. R4's lupus association is weakened by the unremarkable H&E and absence of inflammatory changes on biopsy.

rejected.why: Append-only completion of R3, adds no new raw support beyond echo findings; redundant restatement.
Append-only completion of R4, adds no new raw support beyond echo findings; redundant restatement.

Lupus cardiomyopathy is less supported because biopsy shows no inflammatory infiltrate and the clinical picture is better explained by uremic or hypertensive cardiomyopathy.
